connector.name: Codabench MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for the Codabench REST API - drives a full ML-benchmark participant workflow.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package codabench-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the harshitagr account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CODABENCH_API_TOKEN
env.description: DRF token for Codabench. Obtain via https://www.codabench.org/api/docs/ > api-token-auth > Try it out.
